This '''uncharted planet''' was located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and was home to a small colony of [[Barundi (species)|Barundi]]. When a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] belonging to [[Illyan Webble]], the president of [[Seraphan Industries]], crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Webble discovered the fabled [[Yavin Vassilika]] in the Barundi village. Several treasure hunters later visited the planet in an effort to retrieve the Vassilika.
